svg.title: Weapon Database — Transparent Crest Icon
svg.desc: The exact approved armory crest centered on a fully transparent square canvas. Original geometry and colors are preserved.

g.title: Weapon Database Armory Crest — v23
g.desc: The v22 crest refined with a connected receiver opening that establishes the foreground rifle edge and merges naturally into the blade V and rear trigger pocket, without a separate rectangular crossing bar. Three mirrored rows of black ports and a centered service recess add detail beside the unbordered gray joining rails. The full-width magazine separators, current colors, native vector construction and transparent surrounding canvas are preserved.
